<thought>Based on the mass spectrum, the most plausible molecular ion (as [M+H]⁺) is m/z ≈ 121 Da, corresponding to a neutral formula C₈H₈O (exact mass ≈ 120.057 Da). Acetophenone (SMILES = CC(=O)c1ccccc1) matches this formula and would give a [M+H]⁺ of 121.064 Da, consistent with the observed peak and the ~8 % M+1 intensity (≈ 8 C atoms). Its ¹H NMR would show a singlet for the methyl group (~2.6 ppm, 3 H) and a set of aromatic protons (5 H) between 7.3–7.9 ppm, matching typical proton shift ranges. Therefore, the SMILES string for the sample is:

CC(=O)c1ccccc1
